newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer gets Egypt pump repair order.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer gets Egypt pump repair order.

text.p: Engineering group Sulzer AG said its pumping equipment unit Roteq had won an order worth 17 million Swiss francs to repair a string of 28-year-old Sulzer irrigation pumps on the Nile river.
Sulzer said the order came from Egypt's public works ministry after a review by the World Bank and experts found repairs would be more economical and better for the environment than replacing them.
It said the decision was a good sign for Sulzer because it had thousands of similar irrigation pumps around the world. The Egyptian order covers 55 pumps for on the upper Nile.
